title: Fix the jafgen command in the DuckDB quickstart
fix: jafgen --years 6 fails with No such option. The fix is jafgen 6.

title: State the Python version the DuckDB quickstart needs
fix: The repo pins networkx 3.7, which needs Python 3.12. The guide named no version.

title: Say where install.sh puts entire on Linux
fix: After a good install, entire version says command not found. The page now names the PATH step.

title: knoxctl install: point at the latest release and list APT prerequisites
fix: The page named 0.9.0 as latest while the installer fetches 0.9.58, and skipped curl, gnupg and sudo.

title: jafgen 0.4.6 dropped --years 11 months before the guide shipped
fix: A bisect across 5 jafgen releases, each in a fresh container, found the first bad release.

title: [Bug]: Migration link in chromadb/config.py error message returns 404
fix: The error message links to a migration page that returns 404. The issue names the new URL.

title: Getting started: write_csv("docs/assets/data/output.csv") fails outside the Polars repo
fix: The guide writes to a folder that exists only inside the Polars repo.

title: Quickstart sets r.encoding after r.text, which raises ValueError
fix: Run in order, the quickstart sets the encoding after it reads r.text, and httpx raises ValueError.
